description: This file contains unit tests for an OptionalType template class, verifying its basic functionality such as construction, assignment, equality comparison, and type conversion. The tests are written using the Google Test framework and are part of the core testing suite of the project.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: A template class for optional values, supporting methods like Clear(), IsSet(), Value(), and operator overloading for comparison and assignment.

methods.name: operator int()
methods.description: Converts an OptionalType<int> to an integer value, defaulting to 0 if not set.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Clears the value held by the OptionalType object.

methods.name: IsSet()
methods.description: Checks if the OptionalType object currently holds a value.

methods.name: Value()
methods.description: Retrieves the stored value from the OptionalType object.
